Name: Game Port
Description: Main game traffic (UDP). Must match serverPort in server_config.toml inside the game data directory.

Name: Status Query Port
Description: S1DS status query endpoint (TCP). Mapped to the container's serverPort TCP listener.

Name: Steam Query Port
Description: Steam game server query port (UDP). Must match steamGameServerQueryPort in server_config.toml. Default moved off 27016 to avoid clashing with other Steam servers on this host.
